svg.title: Timeout & Fallback
svg.desc: Timeout & Fallback. Bound every remote call and degrade gracefully when the time runs out. Step 1, No timeout: No timeout: the service waits as long as Recommendations hangs, and the user gives up first. Step 2, Bound the call: A 300 ms timeout frees the caller, but the page still fails: slow has turned into broken. Step 3, Fall back: An optional call that times out gets a fallback: the page arrives with one degraded section. Step 4, One deadline per request: A 1,000 ms deadline caps every call at the time left, and a cancelled call stops work downstream.
